description: An uncommon inflammatory disorder of hair follicles that can cause patchy, progressive and permanent scarring hair loss.
symptoms: Hair loss may be accompanied by itch, pain, tenderness, discomfort or burning.
causes: The exact cause is unknown; an autoimmune response directed at hair follicles is suspected.
risk_factors: It may occur with lichen planus affecting skin, mucosa or nails.

appearance.general: Smooth white patches of scalp hair loss with loss of visible follicular openings; scale and perifollicular redness can occur at the edges.

warning_signs: Progressive scarring hair loss warrants professional assessment because hair loss can become permanent.
